name: jam
author: ffalt
description: jam monorepo: jamserve audio server, jamberry web client and the ffalt/jam docker image

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix jamserve && npm install --prefix jamberry
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix jamserve && npm ci --prefix jamberry
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix jamserve && npm run build --prefix jamberry
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:deploy --prefix jamserve && npm run build:deploy --prefix jamberry
scripts.test: npm test --prefix jamserve && npm test --prefix jamberry
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix jamserve && npm run lint --prefix jamberry
